description: Present already retrieved source results as source cards when the host supports UI, with a complete readable text list otherwise. Use when the user wants to browse sources or a visual list helps the task. Pass existing results in the desired order; never invent source URLs or factual titles. Does not search, crawl, fetch URLs, verify sources, or consume search credits. Do not call for intermediate research results or when a text answer is sufficient.

results.description: Already retrieved results, in the order to display. No new search is performed.

id.description: Copy the original result ID when available. If absent, the server uses its URL.

metadata.description: Optional original JSON source metadata. Do not put credentials or UI implementation details here.

text.description: Optional source snippet or faithful excerpt, not a full page or model-written answer.

title.description: Copy the source title; do not invent or rewrite factual source titles.

url.description: Absolute HTTP(S) source URL, without embedded credentials.

title.description: Optional human-readable list heading. Defaults to Results.
